Interface ServerProxy

All Superinterfaces:
VirtualServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
RmiServerProxy, SocketServerProxy
public interface ServerProxy extends VirtualServer
Client-side abstraction for the connection to the game server.

Extends VirtualServer with lifecycle methods (connect(), disconnect(), isConnected()) and a wiring hook (setClientController(ClientController)) that lets the implementing proxy instantiate its ClientNetworkDispatcher once the controller is available.

Concrete implementations are provided for RMI (RmiServerProxy) and Socket (SocketServerProxy). Instances are created via ServerProxyFactory.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      void connect() throws Exception
      Establishes the physical connection to the server.

      For RMI, performs the registry lookup and exports this object as a remote stub. For Socket, opens the TCP connection and starts the reader and ping threads. Must be called after setClientController(ClientController) and before any outbound request is issued.

      Throws:
      Exception - if the connection cannot be established

    • disconnect

      void disconnect()
      Closes the connection and releases all associated resources (threads, sockets, RMI stubs).

      Implementations must set an intentional-disconnect flag so that background threads do not trigger an automatic reconnection attempt.

    • isConnected

      boolean isConnected()
      Returns whether the proxy currently has an active connection to the server.
      Returns:
      true if connected, false otherwise

    • setClientController

      void setClientController(ClientController controller)
      Wires this proxy to the given ClientController and creates the ClientNetworkDispatcher that routes inbound server notifications to the appropriate client-side model.

      Must be called before connect() so that inbound events are dispatched correctly as soon as the connection is live.

      Parameters:
      controller - the client controller that owns the active model
